what_each_new_part_touches: each link clips to the next (side box: 28 links per loop, make 2)
the left loop wraps around gear-1 and gear-2, the right loop around gear-3 and gear-4; the gear teeth sit in the links
who_does_what_to_which: gear-1 and gear-2 hold the left loop tight
gear-3 and gear-4 hold the right loop tight
beam9-X supports the left loop through gear-1 and gear-2
beam9-Y supports the right loop through gear-3 and gear-4
where_everything_is_after: a closed track loop on each side

why.why_these_parts: Tread links clip into a loop of any length and their teeth fit a 16-tooth gear, so two gears per side make a track.
why.sets_up_for_later: The undercarriage is finished; step 16 flips it over to build the top.
why.design_pattern: track loop around two idler gears
